verses.text: Because the Lord is my Shepherd, I have everything I need!
He lets me rest in the meadow grass and leads me beside the quiet streams. He gives me new strength. He helps me do what honors him the most.
Even when walking through the dark valley of death I will not be afraid, for you are close beside me, guarding, guiding all the way.

footnotes.text: guarding, guiding all the way, literally, “your rod and your staff comfort me.”

verses.text: You provide delicious food for me in the presence of my enemies. You have welcomed me as your guest; blessings overflow!

footnotes.text: You have welcomed me as your guest, literally, “You have anointed my head with oil, my cup runs over.”

verses.text: Your goodness and unfailing kindness shall be with me all of my life, and afterwards I will live with you forever in your home.
